up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL1336 (SORAFENIB) and all its salt/derivative forms by using the molecule_hierarchy table to map the parent compound and all related forms. The activities must be against target CHEMBL279 (Vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2). Filter the activities to only include those with standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Return exactly the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    a.description AS assay_description,
    act.standard_type,
    act.standard_relation,
    act.standard_value,
    act.standard_units,
    act.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN activities act ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = a.tid
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
WHERE
    (
        md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'
        OR mh.parent_molregno IN (
            SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'
        )
    )
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'
    AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND act.standard_units = 'nM';
